title: Pure Die Roll
summary: Pure Die Roll control and OTK build uniting Yu-Gi-Oh!'s strongest six-sided die-rolling monsters, Spells, and Traps with That Six to rig every outcome in your favor.

summary.title: Starters & Enablers
points: Dimension Dice Tributes any monster you control while you control a card with a die-roll effect to Special Summon Orgoth the Relentless, Snipe Hunter, or Skull Archfiend of Lightning directly from your hand or Deck.
Summon Dice pays 1000 LP and rolls a die to grant an extra Normal Summon (1 or 2), revive a monster from the GY (3 or 4), or Special Summon a Level 5 or higher monster from the hand (5 or 6).
That Six is the Continuous Trap centerpiece: whenever either player rolls a die, you can treat an odd result (1, 3, 5) as a 6, or treat an even result (2, 4, 6) as a 1.

summary.title: Opening: Summon Dice / Dimension Dice + That Six
steps: Summon a die-roll monster such as Snipe Hunter or Dice Jar and activate Dimension Dice to Tribute a monster and Special Summon Orgoth the Relentless from the Deck.
Roll 3 dice with Orgoth the Relentless to gain up to 1800 ATK and DEF and unlock battle and effect destruction immunity, direct attacks, or double attacks.
Set That Six and Dicephoon or Skull Dice so every subsequent die roll on either turn lands on the exact result you need.

summary.title: Rigging the Dice with That Six
summary.text: With That Six face-up, every gamble becomes reliable. Dice Jar makes both players roll a die and inflicts 6000 burn damage if the winner rolled a 6; That Six turns any odd roll of yours (1, 3, 5) into a 6 while turning any even roll of the opponent's (2, 4, 6) into a 1. Likewise, Skull Archfiend of Lightning negates and destroys any card effect that targets it on a 1, 3, or 6, which That Six guarantees on every roll, while Snipe Hunter discards cards to pop opposing threats without a once-per-turn limit.

summary.title: Bosses, Spells & Traps
points: Orgoth the Relentless and Maximum Six act as high-ATK beatsticks that scale with their die rolls, boosted further by Graceful Dice while Skull Dice shrinks opposing monsters.
Dicephoon destroys 1 Spell/Trap on a 2, 3, or 4 (or 2 Spells/Traps on a 5) at Quick-Play speed, and Blind Destruction rolls every Standby Phase to destroy all face-up monsters matching that Level.

Number 85: Crazy Box is a 3000 ATK Rank 4 Xyz that detaches a material to roll a die for draws, removal, or negation, while Masterking Archfiend rolls a die whenever a Fiend is sent to the GY to recover, recycle, or revive Fiends.

allow.Skull Archfiend of Lightning: 2500 ATK Fiend that rolls a six-sided die whenever targeted by an opponent's card effect and negates/destroys it on a 1, 3, or 6.
allow.Blind Destruction: Continuous Trap that rolls a six-sided die during every Standby Phase and destroys all face-up monsters on the field whose Level equals the result.
allow.Masterking Archfiend: Link-2 Fiend that rolls a die whenever a Fiend is sent to the GY to add it to hand, shuffle it to Deck, or Special Summon it.

main: Orgoth the Relentless
Signature Level 7 Warrior that rolls a six-sided die 3 times to gain ATK/DEF x 100 and unlock battle/effect immunity, direct attacks, or double attacks based on matching/high rolls.
Snipe Hunter
Discards 1 card to target any card on the field and roll a die; destroys the target on anything except a 1 or 6 (100% guaranteed destruction while That Six is face-up!).
Dice Jar
Flip monster where both players roll a six-sided die and the loser takes burn damage equal to the winner's roll x 500 (or exactly 6000 damage if the winner rolls a 6!).
Maximum Six
Rolls a die when Tribute Summoned and gains ATK equal to the result x 200.
Skull Archfiend of Lightning
2500 ATK Fiend that rolls a six-sided die whenever targeted by an opponent's card effect and negates/destroys it on a 1, 3, or 6.
That Six
Core Continuous Trap: every time either player rolls a die, you can turn any 1, 3, or 5 into a 6, OR turn any 2, 4, or 6 into a 1 (rigging Dice Jar, Snipe Hunter, and Orgoth!).
Dimension Dice
Tributes 1 monster you control while you control a card with a die-roll effect to Special Summon Orgoth the Relentless or any die-roll monster directly from your hand or Deck.
Summon Dice
Pays 1000 LP and rolls a die to grant an extra Normal Summon (1-2), revive a monster from the GY (3-4), or Special Summon a Level 5+ monster from the hand (5-6).
Dicephoon
Quick-Play Spell that rolls a die to destroy 1 Spell/Trap on the field (2, 3, 4) or 2 Spells/Traps on the field (5).
Graceful Dice
Quick-Play Spell that rolls a die and boosts the ATK/DEF of all monsters you currently control by the result x 100.
Skull Dice
Trap that rolls a die and reduces the ATK/DEF of all monsters your opponent currently controls by the result x 100.
Blind Destruction
Continuous Trap that rolls a die every Standby Phase to destroy all monsters matching that Level.
extra: Rank 4 Xyz with 3000 ATK that detaches 1 material to roll a six-sided die for various effects.
Link-2 Fiend that rolls a die whenever a Fiend is sent to the GY.
